observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT
Safety: CAUTION
Issues: Lateral CXR shows posterior costophrenic sulcus blunting consistent with a small pleural effusion, but left vs right cannot be reliably determined because both hemidiaphragms are superimposed; the “LT LAT” marker indicates a left lateral projection, not a left-sided effusion; no frontal/decubitus view confirms lateralization.
Suggestion: Confirm the side with a frontal radiograph or radiology report before accepting “left”; treat the side as uncertain from this lateral image alone.
